item.title: (Calendar of events)
item.description: Calendar items may be sent to newsroom@news-star.com or to vicky.misa@news-star.com.

item.title: Applications open for OKC Zoo Living Classroom Grant
item.description: Applications are now open for the OKC Zoo Living Classroom Grant Program, presented by OG&E. The Oklahoma City Zoo and Botanical Garden encourages OKC metro-area schools to apply for the OKC Zoo Living Classroom Grant, which includes professional development opportunities for teachers, access to the National Wildlife Federation’s Monarch Mission Curriculum, and up to $1,500 for each school selected to purchase supplies to create a monarch garden.

item.title: Representative urges Senate to vote on Rain's Law, protect Oklahoma students from fentanyl
item.description: OKLAHOMA CITY — Rep. Ronny Johns, R-Ada, is renewing a call for action on Rain’s Law, House Bill 1484, legislation that would require age-appropriate fentanyl abuse prevention and drug poisoning awareness education in Oklahoma schools.

item.title: Dale rolls to Thursday home victories over Latta
item.description: DALE - It doesn’t take an astute basketball analyst to figure out how Dale beat Latta Thursday night. In the matchup of ranked teams in both games, both Latta teams scored only two points in the second quarter and Dale pulled away.

item.title: Shawnee Public Schools adds equipment to help with maintenance
item.description: Thanks to voter support in passing the 2024 bond, Shawnee Public Schools has added a new 50-foot boom lift to its maintenance fleet. This investment allows crews to respond faster and more efficiently to repairs across the district, with no more costly rentals or long wait times.

item.title: McLoud girls capture 20th win of the season, stay unbeaten
item.description: McLOUD – The unbeaten McLoud Lady Redskins notched their 20th victory of the season Friday night with a convincing 81-35 rout of the Stroud Lady Tigers.

item.title: Pirates knock off Vanoss to improve to 20-2 on season
item.description: DALE – The Class 2A top-ranked Dale Pirates found themselves in a battle with the fifth-ranked Vanoss Wolves Friday night.

item.title: Arkansas Tech women escape with overtime decision over Bison
item.description: RUSSELLVILLE, Ark. – Oklahoma Baptist pushed a nationally ranked Arkansas Tech squad to the brink on Saturday afternoon, but the Bison ultimately fell 80–75 in overtime at Tucker Coliseum.

item.title: McLoud girls smother Okemah; Redskins edged by late shot
item.description: McLOUD – What a disruptive force the unbeaten McLoud Lady Redskins can be.

item.title: NRC boys suffer first setback, Lady Cougars also fall
item.description: North Rock Creek played with fire a few times this season, but they had always managed to escape undefeated. Friday night, 3A No. 17 Sequoyah-Tahlequah ended the Cougars undefeated start to the season with a 67-59 upset.
